body:
- Each task separate token (we can use universal tokens issuing, but user should be able to use each token in such way) - for audit/monitoring/security/isolation
- Claude Max subscription usage inside Codex, and ChatGPT Pro usage inside Claude Code and so on (in any agentic CLI, like qwen, gemini, opencode, grok build, cursor CLI and so on) for compatibility reasons

So the general purpose of the system is usage as an internal component of personal or corporate infrastructure, for testing, experimenting and general coding tasks.

We need to make sure each possible use case is carefully documented, we use separate documentation files for each of them (so user is not distracted).

And everything that documented must be tested locally (using copy of available subscription, you can temporary copy your own codex or claude folder and claude.json or both if available, and test copy of these folders in docker container (docker is available for you locally).

Based on testing locally you can increase unit tests coverage.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Make sure we have documented and supported use cases
